svg.title: Workflow: NBFC customer support transformation
svg.desc: Solution workflow (event-triggered) for NBFC customer support transformation: 1 trigger: Email lands in the service or complaints inbox → email integration creates one ticket per thread; 2 workflow: Fires once on ticket creation and calls the support agent → one AI action; 3 guardrail: Agent scans title, body, sender and display name for authority signals → authority flag; 4 decision: Authority or regulatory sender? yes → classify as complaint, zero reply, human queue / no → step 5; 5 agent: Classifies category and sub-category, applies inbox and email-type rules, searches KB, masks PII → structured output; 6 workflow: Sets category, sub-category, group atomically → routed ticket; 7 decision: Reply allowed and KB content found? yes → step 8 / no → fallback template or silent routing to human; 8 agent: Posts the multilingual KB reply as an external comment → customer email, stage awaiting customer; 9 workflow: No reply within N days → resolved then closed; customer follow-ups go to humans → closed or human-owned ticket; 10 human: Complaints and regulator mail handled in the complaints group → human resolution; 11 outcome: Fewer manual touches with regulator-safe automation (targets) → lower triage load
